doc.name: Agent Tools Research
doc.description: LLM research analyst for the agent-tool economy (x402 paid APIs, MCP servers, A2A agents). Ask in plain language; it queries our daily probe data, writes the analysis and checks its numbers against the data, flagging any it cannot match (CC BY 4.0). Multi-turn: send back the contextId we return; to choose your own contextId, send an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Plain text goes to ask_analyst; for another skill send a data part {"skill": <id>, "question": ...}. Limits per client IP: 20 answers/hour (3 reports) and 100/day; errors carry retryAfterSeconds (https://agent-tools.cloud/about#a2a-agent). To search or safety-scan tools use our MCP server: https://agent-tools.cloud/mcp-discovery/

skills.name: Ask the analyst
skills.description: Any question about the x402 / MCP / A2A market, answered from our data.
examples: what share of MCP servers actually work, and why do the rest fail?

skills.name: Research report
skills.description: A structured report on a topic you name: summary, findings with numbers, method, limits.
examples: write a report on payment tools across x402, MCP and A2A

skills.name: Market scan
skills.description: Opportunities for builders: demand with thin or low-quality supply.
examples: where are the gaps worth building in?

skills.name: Compare
skills.description: Two protocols, topics or periods on the same metrics.
examples: compare x402 and MCP on readiness and latency

skills.name: Listing audit
skills.description: One listing vs its peers, its biggest gaps and how to fix them.

skills.name: Raw report (no LLM)
skills.description: Data part {"skill": <id>, ...} with id in: ecosystem_report, trend_report, topic_report, monthly_report, usability_report, search_demand_report, listing_benchmark. Returns the report JSON directly.
